description: Gate 2 Step 5 batch 1 — repair 23 meta descriptions that open with a stuffed lowercase keyword prefix. 20 of them also ended mid-sentence in an ellipsis, so both defects are fixed in one edit rather than touching those rows twice. Measured before this batch: 62 of 200 published articles had a defective description (59 ellipsis, 23 stuffed prefix, overlapping by 20). Replacements are hand-written, 129-150 characters, complete sentences. The 3 Arabic ones opened with a bare English word and were rewritten as Arabic rather than repaired as translations. description column only; title, slug, keywords and content untouched. The remaining 39 ellipsis-only descriptions are a later batch.
